rectifiable.note: Not resolved by this site's searches. Exact column sweeps rule out every rectangle with a side of at most 80 and every half-strip of width at most 80, and exhaustive search rules out every rectangle holding at most 24 copies.

order.note: Every tileable rectangle has both sides above 80, so it holds at least 657 copies; the piece may not tile any rectangle.

tilesHalfStrip.note: No half-strip of width at most 80 can be tiled (exact column search, tools/side-bounds.ts); wider half-strips are undecided.

tilesPlane.reason: A periodic tiling exists with 2 copies per period (period lattice (4, 0), (0, 5)).
